RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of unlawful bias, and raising allegations without concrete documentation will severely damage your professional reputation in municipal government. 

For director-level roles, selection panels often prioritize executive presence, political acumen, and stakeholder relations over purely technical credentials—areas where extensive public consultation experience is highly valued. Furthermore, a two-week delay in post-interview debriefs is routine in municipal HR processes. 

Instead of questioning the panel's demographics, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused on your interview performance. Use this to strengthen your candidacy for future leadership positions rather than pursuing an unsubstantiated discrimination claim.
